sections.text_helper: Section 14.4.12 "TIM1 and TIM8 auto-reload register (TIMx_ARR)" in chapter 14 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1 and TIM8)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 356.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0xFFFF
Bits 15:0 ARR[15:0]: Auto-reload value
ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register.
Refer to Section14.3.1: Time-base unit for more details about ARR update and behavior.
The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.
